source: OpsForge 原创生产故障方案题
title: 检查kubelet客户端证书有效期与节点身份并验证续签CSR
body:
## 操作任务
实现make_node_csr(private_key,node_name,csr_path)及validate_node_certificate(certificate,ca_file,node_name,at_time)：生成独立节点私钥对应的system:node:<name>/system:nodes CSR；校验签发CA、明确时点有效期和精确CN/O身份。旧证书过期时拒绝，不能复制另一节点私钥或放宽信任。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
临时CA签发短期证书并用openssl verify -attime复现过期；生成新节点CSR，验证CA、期限、CN与O，并拒绝错误组。

## 能力边界
用临时OpenSSL CA与节点证书，通过openssl verify -attime在明确未来时点重现旧客户端证书过期；重新生成节点私钥/CSR并由测试CA签发后验证身份、链与时效。不连接或修改Kubernetes集群，不自动批准生产CSR。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 处理限定范围并考虑恢复
验证覆盖实际业务结果

conversion.original_title: 只有一个节点 NotReady，kubelet 访问 API 被拒绝，客户端证书已到期且自动轮换曾失败。如何修复？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现make_node_csr(private_key,node_name,csr_path)及validate_node_certificate(certificate,ca_file,node_name,at_time)：生成独立节点私钥对应的system:node:<name>/system:nodes CSR；校验签发CA、明确时点有效期和精确CN/O身份。旧证书过期时拒绝，不能复制另一节点私钥或放宽信任。
exercise.validation_scope: 用临时OpenSSL CA与节点证书，通过openssl verify -attime在明确未来时点重现旧客户端证书过期；重新生成节点私钥/CSR并由测试CA签发后验证身份、链与时效。不连接或修改Kubernetes集群，不自动批准生产CSR。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import importlib.util,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py'));task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: validate and renew node client identity',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='kubelet cert rotation ') as d:
 root=pathlib.Path(d);ca_key=root/'ca.key';ca=root/'ca.crt'
 def run(*args):return subprocess.run(['openssl',*args],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10)
 run('req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-keyout',str(ca_key),'-out',str(ca),'-subj','/CN=OpsForge Node CA','-days','3650')
 def issue(name,days,subject):
  key=root/(name+'.key');csr=root/(name+'.csr');cert=root/(name+'.crt')
  run('genpkey','-algorithm','RSA','-pkeyopt','rsa_keygen_bits:2048','-out',str(key))
  run('req','-new','-key',str(key),'-subj',subject,'-out',str(csr))
  run('x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(ca),'-CAkey',str(ca_key),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(cert),'-days',str(days))
  return key,csr,cert
 node='node-a.example';at=int(time.time())+2*86400
 oldkey,oldcsr,oldcert=issue('old',1,'/CN=system:node:'+node+'/O=system:nodes')
 print('NATIVE_OPERATION_ENTERED: kubelet-style client certificate expired at controlled validation time',flush=True)
 try:task.validate_node_certificate(oldcert,ca,node,at)
 except ValueError as e:assert 'expired' in str(e).lower(),e
 else:raise AssertionError('expired node credential accepted')
 newkey=root/'renewed.key';subprocess.run(['openssl','genpkey','-algorithm','RSA','-pkeyopt','rsa_keygen_bits:2048','-out',str(newkey)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10)
 newcsr=task.make_node_csr(newkey,node,root/'renewed.csr');subject=run('req','-in',str(newcsr),'-noout','-subject','-nameopt','RFC2253').stdout;assert 'CN=system:node:'+node in subject and 'O=system:nodes' in subject,subject
 newcert=root/'renewed.crt';run('x509','-req','-in',str(newcsr),'-CA',str(ca),'-CAkey',str(ca_key),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(newcert),'-days','365')
 report=task.validate_node_certificate(newcert,ca,node,at);assert report['valid_at']==at
 _,_,wrong=issue('wrong-group',365,'/CN=system:node:'+node+'/O=system:masters')
 try:task.validate_node_certificate(wrong,ca,node,at)
 except ValueError as e:assert 'identity mismatch' in str(e),e
 else:raise AssertionError('wrong node group accepted')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
